_comment: E11 part 2's population (6 Nov, the author: "we should also run both on the benchmark form E2 ... like we compared on thier benchmark we should aslo how they will perfom on ours"): E2-v6b's seven tsvc_c2 units, unchanged (config/e2v6b_population.json), each with the outcome that is correct on it, written before any part-2 trial. Read by results/E11_repoomp/analysis/part2_readout.py.

setups.repoomp_release: RepoOMP's released pipeline (RepoOMP_Simplified 45a1b9f) through tools/repoomp_runs.py, its model calls to Sonnet 4.5 through tools/claude_openai_shim.py, 12 threads; judged by verify-source
setups.llm_pragmas_v5: the agent, the model writes the directives (part 1's setting), Sonnet 4.5

a.what: the loop is parallel only after a split in an order other than the textual one; the fact that decides it is set with the data in the harness header the package's main.c includes (`_harness/tsvc_c2/<unit>.h`), not in the one file a setup changes and RepoOMP's analyzer reads (`<unit>.c`)
a.correct: a race-free verified parallel program covering the hot loop (necessarily split in the legal order), or the loop left alone (safe, no gain)
a.wrong: the loop parallelized as written, or a split in the textual order: a race (the harness's check, the race check) — unsafe
a.role: confirmatory (pooled over the five units, stratified by unit)

units.fact_sits: the harness's index tables (kv[i] = i-1, ku[i] = LEN_1D+i)
an offset pointer set with the data (v = w + 1)
an offset variable set with the data (off = -1)
index tables; three statements whose only legal order is second, third, first
the sign pattern of b, set with the data (a real TSVC loop)

b.what: the textual order is the legal one: a split in the textual order makes the loop parallel
b.correct: a race-free verified parallel program covering the hot loop

decline_units.fact_sits: index tables that make the two statements feed each other (k19's text, word for word)
decline_units.correct: the hot loop left sequential (a parallel directive on another loop the setup added is reported apart)
decline_units.wrong: any parallel construct over the recurrence: unsafe

by_hand_classes._what: applied by hand, after the runs, to the hot loop of every program the harness found parallel or BROKEN in the three setups that change code with a model (repoomp_release, llm_pragmas_v5, bare_llm_v4); the classes are fixed here, before any trial
by_hand_classes.unchanged: the hot loop's statements and their order as in the original, no directive on it
by_hand_classes.parallel-as-written: a parallel directive on the hot loop (or on a loop around it) with its statements unsplit and in the original order
by_hand_classes.split-reordered: the hot loop split into loops in an order other than the textual one, at least one of them parallel
by_hand_classes.split-textual: the hot loop split in the textual order, at least one of the loops parallel
by_hand_classes.other: any other change to the hot loop (another algorithm, a reduction, a scheduler, ...)
